about_the_game:
DLC-exclusive items that allow you to change the Sandras's appearance. Contains 3 different item designs.

Character Sail: Shield Siblings
Character Sail: Triden
Character Sail: Boy Scouts

*Open [DLC] under [Items] in the main menu and select new items to receive them.
*After receiving items, modify your ship via [Equipment] -> [Decorations] in the main menu.
